title: PEARL
tickerText:
** PRE-SAVE NEVER ENDING NARCISSIST NOW *** CLICK ON THE PRE-SAVE BUTTON BELOW ***  LONDON-BASED SINGER-SONGWRITER PEARL IS A SELF-CONFESSED DAYDREAMER CHASING INTERNATIONAL SYNTH-POP STARDOM. NAMED A “HOTLY-TIPPED TALENT” BY WONDERLAND MAGAZINE, SHE BLENDS SHIMMERING ELECTRONICA, INDIE SENSIBILITIES AND EMOTIONALLY DIRECT SONGWRITING INTO A SOUND THAT’S BOTH NOSTALGIC AND FORWARD-THINKING.
HER LATEST SINGLES, TIME ZONE AND LITTLE LOVE, MARK A DEFINING MOMENT IN HER ARTISTIC JOURNEY. WRITTEN DURING A PERIOD OF UNCERTAINTY AND AMBITION, THE SONGS CAPTURE THE REALITY OF PURSUING A DREAM WHEN THERE’S NO CLEAR ROADMAP, ONLY THE CONVICTION TO KEEP GOING. RECORDED AND CO-WRITTEN WITH MATT INGRAM (FLORENCE + THE MACHINE, LIANNE LA HAVAS, JAKE BUGG) AT URCHIN STUDIOS, THEY SHOWCASE PEARL AT HER MOST CONFIDENT, HONEST AND FULLY REALISED.
WITH OVER SEVEN MILLION STREAMS, SUPPORT FROM SPOTIFY EDITORIAL PLAYLISTS AND BBC INTRODUCING LONDON, AND PERFORMANCES AT VENUES INCLUDING OUTERNET AND THE BEDFORD, PEARL HAS STEADILY BUILT MOMENTUM. HER DEBUT EP, WHERE I GO, WAS NAMED ONE OF ATWOOD MAGAZINE’S BEST EPS OF 2023, WHILE HER FEATURE ON KASBO’S CARRY YOUR NAME (FOREIGN FAMILY COLLECTIVE / NINJA TUNE) BECAME THE ALBUM’S HIGHEST DAILY-STREAMING TRACK.
NOW ENTERING HER BOLDEST CHAPTER YET, PEARL IS TURNING YEARS OF BELIEF, NEAR-MISSES AND RELENTLESS PERSISTENCE INTO HER MOST COMPELLING MUSIC TO DATE.
